initial_profile_equilibrium_mode.provenance: Derived source-compatible record-layout choice: BasInf reads the tenth basic-information flag as lEquil. NodInf runs before ChemIn and, with lChem=true and NS=3, lEquil=true selects 13 numeric fields per node (10 node/temperature fields plus 3 dissolved concentrations), omitting explicit sorbed columns. Zero initial equilibrium sorbed pools follow from zero dissolved concentrations. ChemIn later derives its own equilibrium mode from Fraction=1 and ImmobileWaterContent=0; this flag is not evidence of a recovered manual deck. Source: INPUT.FOR:31-32,248-252,1332-1339; HYDRUS.FOR:196-199,271-277.
